newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Harkin critical of Greenspan testimony.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Harkin critical of Greenspan testimony.

text.p: Senator Tom Harkin Friday criticized Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony Thursday at a Joint Economic Committee hearing which appeared to indicate the Fed would raise interest rates soon.

"This is yet another example of the Federal Reserve Board's misguided policies -- instead of fighting real inflation, the Fed seems to be spellbound by the mythical ghost of inflation," Harkin, D-Iowa, said in a statement.
"Instead of raising interest rates, there seems to be more reasons for the Fed to actually lower rates," Harkin said.
